title: Neurotypical woman with a head injury reaches the space non-speakers touch

tellings.quote: 92 there's a a neurotypical woman who has a head injury that is able to touch the space that non-speakers can touch

plain: A neurotypical woman with a head injury is said to be able to "touch the space that non-speakers can touch". Non-speakers here are people who cannot talk, whom the documentary series The Telepathy Tapes says can share thoughts by mind. Ky Dickens, who made the series, passes this on from one of the people she came across, as a hint that this mental space is not limited to non-speakers.
